title.zh: 将索索贡省胡班市镇胡班小学的名称变更为Jose G. Alindogan小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Juban Elementary School, in the Municipality of Juban, Province of Sorsogon, to Jose G. Alindogan Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Juban Elementary School, in the Municipality of Juban, Province of Sorsogon, to Jose G. Alindogan Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Juban Elementary School, tại Thị trấn Juban, Tỉnh Sorsogon thành Trường tiểu học Jose G. Alindogan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Juban Elementary School, ในเทศบาล Juban, จังหวัด Sorsogon เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Jose G. Alindogan
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Juban Elementary School, di Kotamadya Juban, Provinsi Sorsogon menjadi Sekolah Dasar Jose G. Alindogan
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Juban Elementary School, di Perbandaran Juban, Wilayah Sorsogon menjadi Sekolah Rendah Jose G. Alindogan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_4899_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Juban Elementary School in the Municipality of Juban, Province of Sorsogon, is hereby changed to Jose G. Alindogan Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
